text:
Eli (Product): follow-up from today's all-hands pricing Q&A. Capturing quick clarifications folks asked for.

Maya (Finance): quick summary: tokens consumed as usual. We enforce per-route and per-org quotas. Paid tiers get a short grace burst (standard: 15s, enterprise: 30s). After that, requests subject to quota windows or 429s.

Harpreet (Billing): credits expiry note: promo credits 12 months, trial credits 90 days. Enterprise contracts can override. We also support an optional auto-topup that requires a billing agreement.

Jordan (Support): on 429 responses we include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Window`, and `Retry-After`. Response body example (text): "{error: 'rate_limited', retry_after_seconds: 60}". We're piloting `X-Credit-Balance` for opt-in customers.

sam_r (eng): Dedicated customers: reserved capacity doesn't draw hosted credits. If customer opts into cross-fallback, hosted units are consumed only during fallback. We try smoothing + model-variant fallback before returning 429 when possible.

Eli (Product): demo launches — can customers request temporary extra throughput?

Maya (Finance): yes. Demo passes exist: standard paid plans get 48-hour auto-approve up to 2x baseline; partners get 72-hour up to 3x. Anything beyond requires Sales approval. Request via Support with expected TPS and token/sec.

Harpreet (Billing): programmatic checks: `GET /v1/account/credits` (lightly rate-limited) and `GET /v1/usage/summary` (per-route). Example plaintext response: "balance: 12000, expires_at: 2027-06-01T00:00:00Z".

Jordan (Support): refunds/adjustments: we audit and can issue credit adjustments if consumption due to platform error or documented misconfig; typical turnaround 3-7 business days. Include request ids and timestamps in ticket.

Ava (CEO): high-level: no pricing changes planned next quarter. We'll publish model-family pricing guidance and quantization discount examples in the next product update.

Eli (Product): action items: I'll draft an FAQ with header examples, sample backoff code (respect Retry-After + jitter), and a KB article for demo passes. Will post by EOD and link here.

NotesBot: Slides + transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/all-hands/2026-04-10/pricing

Maya (Finance): last note: for orgs using Hosted + Dedicated under same billing, Dedicated is billed first; hosted credits cover fallthrough. We're working on an "effective credit burn" metric for the console.

Jordan (Support): I'll prepare customer-facing wording and examples and tag @Eli for review.

Eli (Product): thanks all — if partners want EA access to quota shadow mode DM me. :thumbsup:
